Only the clients and servers that have a legitimate procedural relationship with the service should be permitted to communicate with it. search_text: published ZDI-19-1010 ZDI-CAN-7883 (0Day) Advantech WebAccess Node BwOpcBs Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2019-12-12 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Advantech'] ['WebAccess'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Advantech WebAccess Node. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within BwOpcBs.exe, which is accessed through the 0x2711 IOCTL in the webvrpcs process. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of Administrator.
